name: Whoosh
description: Two-finger window and GNOME dash gestures for GNOME Shell. Swipe title bars to tile, maximize, or minimize; pinch to close or fullscreen. Over dash apps, swipe up to maximize the preferred window, swipe down to minimize all windows, pinch in to quit, and pinch out to open a new window on a new workspace.\n\nRequires the Whoosh backend from the project repository.
